source_policy: Lesson evidence and project paths are intentionally omitted; only generic rule bodies and skill routes are distributed.

rules.title: Retries depend on defect and topology
FMV rounds are global; isolated listening is not a production override
Separate language, content and fallback per delivery
Delivery boundaries require acoustic, linguistic and map evidence
Separate synthesis and QA resources by cohort
Short lines need same-actor reference context
Persist long-run state atomically and resumably
Close only after reauditing real artifacts
Diagnostic encoding cannot block container validation
